flows.intent: Turn newly available long-form source media into a short vertical social clip.

stages.action: resolve source artifact and create job manifest
probe source with ffmpeg/ffprobe
transcribe with WhisperX; local first, Modal fallback
select candidate clip ranges from transcript and intent
cut, remove silence, reframe, caption, mix audio
render 9:16 preview and final MP4
validate media and expected overlays/captions
surface artifacts and status to user or downstream connector

flows.intent: Generate multiple candidate clips from a podcast or interview.

stages.action: word-timestamp transcription
rank self-contained segments by narrative and hook strength
create one child manifest per selected segment
parallel deterministic renders
collect artifacts and terminal states
present candidate outputs and metadata

flows.intent: Revise an existing rendered video without losing prior versions.

stages.action: load prior manifest and user revision intent
append revision operations; never mutate completed history
reuse cached transcript/proxies and rerender changed stages
validate new revision
surface new artifact while retaining previous version references

flows.intent: Generate missing B-roll only when requested and cheaper stock/local assets are insufficient.

stages.action: identify exact B-roll gaps and prompts
select Hugging Face model and Modal GPU class
generate bounded clips
insert generated assets into deterministic timeline
surface result for subjective review before publishing
